text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm off today, and while I'm looking for a
place to
sit and eat in the early
afternoon...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I notice a curious-looking notebook
under one of
the seats.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Aha! Found it! El's Strongest Notebook
in the
World—Número Cuatro!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness! I've been looking
everywhere for
it!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
So it was here all along, huh? I musta
dropped it
while I was eating my super
ultra spicy sandwich
earlier...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Bueno! Muchas gracias for picking it up!
I can't
thank you enough, no matter how
many
languages I use!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Sí! When my papa was a wrestler, he
used to write
down new moves in a
notebook just like this!
choice_data_list: It must be an important notebook to you.
It's a really precious notebook, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
In other words, that notebook is filled
with all the
tricks I've discovered for
running and other
special info—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! I'll tell ya one of the secrets
in this
notebook as my way of thanking
you!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I recommend the "El-Style Power
Training
Program" or "Tips for Race
Running on a Clear
Day"! What'll it be?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yooooou got it! Consider yourself
guaranteed to
explode with power!
choice_data_list: Tips for running in sunny races

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Now lend me your ears! This is
confidential stuff,
y'know!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: So this is what you gotta do! Whisper, whisper, whisper...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Going for the fair-weather offense
tricks,
huh? An excellent choice, if I do
say so myself!

text_block_list.text:

y'know!
